title: Audit Log dialog keeps today's columns without Line, and says when empty
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Use a category on staging, category A, that nobody has changed since the release (so its log is empty).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open the three-dot menu beside New Tier.
  3. Click Audit Log.
  4. Click Close.
  5. Open Settings › Categories.
  6. Click category A's row.
  7. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  8. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Audit Log.

Step 3:

  • "Audit Log: Tiers" opens with a search box and the columns Event, User, Details, Date and Time.
  • It has no Line column.
  • Each detail starts with a tier's name; entries are newest first.
  • Close shows at the bottom.

Step 4:

  • The dialog closes.

Step 5:

  • The Categories page shows.

Step 6:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 7:

  • The menu lists Audit Log.

Step 8:

  • "Audit Log:" and category A's name opens and reads "No history here. Yet."
  • Close is still offered.
